title: Pilot 2 — Live Provider Composition
description:
This layer composes exactly two explicit live provider routes into the existing pure Pilot 2 orchestrator without making Dreaming Worker depend on exe.dev, Cloudflare, or another execution host.

It does not redefine Pilot 2 analytical semantics. `runPilot2` remains the authority for independence checks, terminal outcomes, proposal validation, comparison, and receipt semantics.
context:
This layer composes exactly two explicit live provider routes into the existing pure Pilot 2 orchestrator without making Dreaming Worker depend on exe.dev, Cloudflare, or another execution host.

It does not redefine Pilot 2 analytical semantics. `runPilot2` remains the authority for independence checks, terminal outcomes, proposal validation, comparison, and receipt semantics.

rules.requirement: Live composition preserves the pure Pilot 2 contract
rules:
The composition layer MUST construct the existing OpenAI-compatible inference adapters and delegate to `runPilot2`.

It MUST NOT reinterpret `COMPLETE`, `PARTIAL`, `FAIL_CLOSED`, or `NO_DATA`, and MUST NOT invent consensus, fallback substitution, or new analytical authority.

Every live route MUST supply a positive integer `maxOutputTokens` value before any provider call is possible.

The provider adapter MUST transmit that value as the provider request's output-token bound.

The model-facing Proposal v1 contract MUST be generated from the same canonical Zod schema used for deterministic response validation. A handwritten duplicate schema MUST NOT become a second source of truth.

rules.requirement: Invalid live configuration fails before network work
rules:
Missing route identity, missing base URL, missing/invalid output-token bound, or an invalid route count MUST be rejected before provider work.

Configured same-family routes MUST reach the existing Pilot 2 independence check and terminate `FAIL_CLOSED` before provider work.

Configured route identity and observed provider/model metadata MUST remain separately observable.

Provider-specific JSON framing and bearer authentication are transport options only. They MUST NOT change Pilot 2 analytical semantics or become architectural dependencies on the current execution host.

Transport success MUST NOT be treated as proposal success. A returned artifact still has to pass Proposal v1 JSON, schema, provenance, and Pilot 1 policy validation.

Adapter failures already represented by Pilot 2's typed contract MUST keep that meaning across the composition boundary. In particular, `EMPTY_FINAL_CONTENT` and `OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED` MUST NOT degrade to generic `INFERENCE_FAILED`.
This layer MUST NOT add tools, memory, private Session Search intake, scheduler behavior, critique/conclave, canonical writes, durable ledger/checkpoints, or publication authority.

scenarios.requirement: Live composition preserves the pure Pilot 2 contract
scenarios.name: Two explicit configured-distinct routes are composed
given: AND two explicit live route descriptors
then: both adapters are passed to the existing Pilot 2 orchestrator
AND Pilot 2 remains the owner of terminal outcome and comparison semantics

scenarios.name: A route omits its output-token bound
given: a live route without a positive integer maxOutputTokens
when: live composition validates its route descriptors

scenarios.name: A route has a valid output-token bound
when: the OpenAI-compatible adapter sends the request
then: the provider request carries the corresponding max_tokens value

scenarios.requirement: Invalid live configuration fails before network work
scenarios.name: Same-family routes are configured
given: two otherwise valid live routes with the same model-family identity

scenarios.name: Transport responds but the proposal artifact is invalid
given: a provider returns an HTTP-success response
AND the returned model content does not satisfy Proposal v1
then: transport evidence may record the response
AND the analytical pass remains a typed failure

scenarios.name: Live composition executes
then: it adds no tools, memory, canonical writes, private Session Search intake, scheduler, critique, or publication authority

scenarios.name: Adapter returns no usable final content
given: the live provider adapter reports EMPTY_FINAL_CONTENT or OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED
when: live composition hands the failed pass to Pilot 2
then: the corresponding Pilot 2 failure code is preserved
AND the pass does not degrade to generic INFERENCE_FAILED

scenarios.requirement: Model-facing schema has one source of truth
scenarios.name: A live provider receives the Proposal v1 contract
given: deterministic validation uses the canonical Zod proposalSetSchema
when: the provider adapter builds the system message
then: the model-facing JSON Schema is generated from that same validator
AND handwritten field-type duplication is not the authority

scenarios.name: JSON-object mode or bearer authentication is configured
given: an explicit route requests JSON-object mode or supplies a runtime bearer credential
when: live composition delegates to the generic provider adapter
then: those options are transmitted only at the transport boundary
AND Pilot 2 outcome, validation, comparison, and authority semantics remain unchanged
